subject: MedNova tenant kickoff: gatekeeper origination & keying plan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhao <claire@mednova.com>, MedNova IT <it@mednova.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: MedNova tenant kickoff: gatekeeper origination & keying plan

Hi Claire / MedNova IT team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get MedNova staged. To make the first tenant activation smooth, proposed agenda and immediate asks below: 

Agenda (first week):
- Confirm admin roster (who should receive Redwood org admin + project owner roles)
- Decide staging namespace name (we propose: mednova-staging-1)
- API key strategy: temporary seeded service account keys -> customer rotation cadence
- SSO / SAML and enterprise settings (if you want SSO enabled during staging)
- Invite cadence and approximate dates for user invites

Immediate asks for today:
1) Please reply with the list of admin emails and desired project namespace.
2) Confirm whether you want a dedicated staging project or a shared dev namespace.
3) Attach any internal security policy that affects API key rotation / KMS (if applicable).

I've attached a lightweight onramp checklist and an RBAC template to speed mapping. We'll hold a 30-minute kickoff once we have the admin list — suggested window: Mon Dec 6 at 10am PT (will confirm availability).

Attachments: onramp-checklist.xlsx (worksheet), RBAC-template.csv

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

---

From: Claire Zhao <claire@mednova.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, MedNova IT <it@mednova.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedNova tenant kickoff: gatekeeper origination & keying plan

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and an internal CSV attached with the admin roster.

1) Admin roster (primary): claire@mednova.com (Platform Lead), j.santos@mednova.com (Lead Engineer).
2) We prefer a dedicated staging project — please use mednova-staging-1 as suggested.
3) SSO: we'd like to enable SAML during staging; I'll loop in our identity engineer (it@mednova.com) for the SSO metadata exchange.
4) Procurement: procurement will need the SOW and MSA to sign off before production; we've started DocuSign (route to procure@mednova.com).

Notes / constraints:
- Rotation cadence: security prefers keys rotated every 30 days where possible; if Redwood seeds a temp key we will rotate to our KMS within 30 days.
- Rate limits: we will start with conservative limits for staging — please advise suggested rate ceilings.

Attached: mednova-internal-admins.csv

Looking forward to the kickoff. I can take the Dec 6 slot if it's still available.

Best,
Claire Zhao
Platform Lead, MedNova
claire@mednova.com

Subject: Re: MedNova tenant kickoff: gatekeeper origination & keying plan

Hi Claire — thanks for the roster and SAML note. I've sketched a pragmatic implementation plan below that we'll execute unless you flag changes.

Implementation plan (staging):
- Day 0: Create Redwood org for MedNova and provision project mednova-staging-1.
- Day 1: Seed a short-lived service-account API key into mednova-staging-1 (label: onboarding-temp) so your engineers can smoke test. Key TTL: 30 days.
- Day 2: Exchange SAML metadata (MedNova -> Redwood) and enable SSO for invited users (optional for staging).
- Day 3: Invite admin users (Claire, J. Santos) and the 2 test operators from your CSV.
- Day 5: Run integration smoke tests (token auth, API calls, embedding/response latency sample).

RBAC & rate guidance:
- We'll apply roles from the attached RBAC-template.csv; start with: org_admin (Claire), project_owner (j.santos).
- Suggested staging rate: 5 rps per user / aggregate 50 rps with burst; we'll reassess after initial tests.

Documents and links:
- I've uploaded a minimal tenant config (tenant-config.json) and a one-page runbook draft to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bOnramp-MedNova
- MSA/Procurement: Naomi, I see the DocuSign route — please share the envelope ID when available.

Proposed kickoff time: Mon, Dec 6 at 10:00 PT — Naomi, Marcus and I will join. If that's good for you Claire, I'll schedule a calendar invite and attach the runbook.

Attachments: tenant-config.json

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Hi all — quick operational update ahead of the kickoff: 

- I've created the tenant placeholder and reserved mednova-staging-1 in our control plane.
- I'll seed the onboarding-temp service account key on Day 1 and share the manifest via the Drive folder above. Expect a temporary token artifact (we won't email secrets in plain text — modal share through the Drive link).
- Please confirm the final admin emails (Claire, j.santos@mednova.com) so I can assign org_admin / project_owner roles on Monday morning.
- DocuSign: Naomi, once the MSA is in the envelope please add the Redwood billing contact (billing@redwood.com) and route to procurement@mednova.com.

Operational notes / recommended defaults:
- Key rotation: we recommend you rotate the seeded key into your KMS within 30 days. See implementation-runbook.md in attachments for the exact CLI steps.
- Secrets handling: use the Drive secure share; we'll also add the envelope ID in the kickoff calendar event.

Kickoff: Mon Dec 6, 10:00 PT — I'll post a calendar invite with the Drive links and the runbook attached. If you need an earlier slot, ping me with availability.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Implementation Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
